# netbox_power_feed (Data Source)

Retrieves a single power feed from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_power_feed" "example" {
  name    = "example"
  rack_id = 1
}

output "power_feed_id" {
  value = data.netbox_power_feed.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the power feed.

### Optional

- `cable_id` (Number) The ID of the cable associated with the power feed.
- `rack_id` (Number) The ID of the rack associated with the power feed.

### Read-Only

- `amperage` (Number) The amperage of the power feed.
- `cable_end` (String) The cable end of the power feed.
- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the power feed.
- `connected_endpoints_reachable` (Boolean) The connected endpoints reachable of the power feed.
- `connected_endpoints_type` (String) The connected endpoints type of the power feed.
- `created` (String) When the power feed was created.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the power feed, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the power feed.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_updated` (String) When the power feed was last changed.
- `link_peers_type` (String) The link peers type of the power feed.
- `mark_connected` (Boolean) The mark connected of the power feed.
- `max_utilization` (Number) The max utilization of the power feed.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the power feed.
- `phase` (String) The phase of the power feed.
- `power_panel_id` (Number) The ID of the power panel associated with the power feed.
- `status` (String) The status of the power feed.
- `supply` (String) The supply of the power feed.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
- `tenant_id` (Number) The ID of the tenant associated with the power feed.
- `type` (String) The type of the power feed.
- `voltage` (Number) The voltage of the power feed.
